title: Qian Yang Yu Yin Granule prevents hypertensive cardiac remodeling by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation via Nrf2.
authors: Xu, Junyao; Sun, Zeqi; Li, Jie; Li, Yin; Huang, Hong; Yuan, Fang; Liu, Ming; Fang, Zhuyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Nrf2抑制NLRP3炎症小体改善高血压心脏重构，仅涉及小分子与Keap1-Nrf2蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Qian Yang Yu Yin Granule (QYYYG), a traditional Chinese poly-herbal formulation, has been validated in clinical trials to mitigate cardiac remodeling (CR), and cardiac damage in patients with hypertension. However, the specific mechanism remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study explored the potential effects and potential mechanisms of QYYYG on hypertensive CR by combining various experimental approaches. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs) were used as a model of hypertensive CR, followed by QYYYG interventions. Blood pressure, cardiac function and structure, histopathological changes, and myocardial inflammation and oxidative stress were tested to assess the efficacy of QYYYG in SHRs. For in vitro experiments, a cell model of myocardial hypertrophy and injury was constructed with isoprenaline. Cardiomyocyte hypertrophy, oxidative stress, and death were examined after treatment with different concentrations of QYYYG, and transcriptomics analyses were performed to explore the underlying mechanism. Nrf2 and the ROS/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome pathway were detected. Thereafter, ML385 and siRNAs were used to inhibit Nrf2 in cardiomyocytes, so as to verify whether QYYYG negatively regulates the NLRP3 inflammasome by targeting Nrf2, thereby ameliorating the associated phenotypes. Finally, high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) was conducted to analyze the active ingredients in QYYYG, and molecular docking was utilized to preliminarily screen the compounds with modulatory effects on Nrf2 activities. RESULTS: QYYYG improved blood pressure, cardiac function, and structural remodeling and attenuated myocardial inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death in SHRs. The transcriptomics results showed that the inflammatory response might be crucial in pathological CR and that Nrf2, which potentially negatively regulates the process, was upregulated by QYYYG treatment. Furthermore, QYYYG indeed facilitated Nrf2 activation and negatively regulated the ROS/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome pathway, therefore ameliorating the associated phenotypes. In vitro inhibition or knockdown of Nrf2 weakened or even reversed the repressive effect of QYYYG on ISO-induced inflammation, oxidative stress, pyroptosis, and the NLRP3 inflammasome activation. Based on the results of HPLC and molecular docking, 30 compounds, including cafestol, genistein, hesperetin, and formononetin, have binding sites to Keap1-Nrf2 protein and might affect the activity or stability of Nrf2. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, the alleviatory effect of QYYYG on hypertensive CR is related to its regulation of Nrf2 activation. Specifically, QYYYG blocks the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome by boosting Nrf2 signaling and depressing myocardial inflammation, oxidative stress, and pyroptosis, thereby effectively ameliorating hypertensive CR.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：前阳玉阴颗粒（QYYYG）是一种传统中药复方制剂，已在临床试验中被验证可减轻高血压患者的心脏重构（CR）和心脏损伤。然而，其具体机制尚不明确。研究目的：本研究通过结合多种实验方法，探讨QYYYG对高血压性CR的潜在效应及潜在机制。材料与方法：采用自发性高血压大鼠（SHRs）作为高血压性CR模型，并进行QYYYG干预。检测血压、心脏功能与结构、组织病理学变化以及心肌炎症和氧化应激，以评估QYYYG在SHRs中的疗效。体外实验中，用异丙肾上腺素构建心肌肥大和损伤细胞模型。在不同浓度QYYYG处理后，检测心肌细胞肥大、氧化应激和死亡，并进行转录组学分析以探索潜在机制。检测Nrf2及ROS/NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症小体通路。随后，使用ML385和siRNAs抑制心肌细胞中的Nrf2，以验证QYYYG是否通过靶向Nrf2负调控NLRP3炎症小体，从而改善相关表型。最后，采用高效液相色谱（HPLC）分析QYYYG中的活性成分，并利用分子对接初步筛选对Nrf2活性具有调节作用的化合物。结果：QYYYG改善了SHRs的血压、心脏功能和结构重构，并减轻了心肌炎症、氧化应激和细胞死亡。转录组学结果显示，炎症反应可能在病理性CR中至关重要，而QYYYG处理上调了可能负调控该过程的Nrf2。此外，QYYYG确实促进了Nrf2激活，并负调控ROS/NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症小体通路，从而改善相关表型。体外抑制或敲低Nrf2减弱甚至逆转了QYYYG对ISO诱导的炎症、氧化应激、焦亡及NLRP3炎症小体激活的抑制作用。基于HPLC和分子对接结果，包括咖啡醇、染料木黄酮、橙皮素和芒柄花素在内的30种化合物与Keap1-Nrf2蛋白具有结合位点，可能影响Nrf2的活性或稳定性。结论：总之，QYYYG对高血压性CR的缓解作用与其调节Nrf2激活有关。具体而言，QYYYG通过增强Nrf2信号传导并抑制心肌炎症、氧化应激和焦亡，阻断NLRP3炎症小体的激活，从而有效改善高血压性CR。
